description: A message written while a chat's turn runs, kept by the chat's host in its queue till the turn is over (ChatQueue).

id.description: Its id, the head's pick (a uuid): the uuid it's sent by when it goes alone.

text.description: What's written, as heads show it.

content.description: The message's content as it's sent (a user message's: its text, or its blocks, pictures and documents first).

at.description: When it was queued, epoch seconds.
